name: Serizawa Chiemi
source:
Occupation: College Student
Stay as: Returnee

With a friendly and sociable personality, Chiemi is a college student that returned to her hometown of Fujiyoshi. She is the first person that Haruaki encounters upon his arrival.

Chiemi lives in room 202 of the student dorm.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
